params_used.changed_area_fraction: share of pixels whose own Y moved >= lum_delta since the previous sample with the darker < dark_max
params_used.flashes: consecutive opposing transitions paired in order; lum_flashes / red_flashes count a flash once in each window its span [first, second transition] touches, so one straddling a window edge counts in both; *_flashes_fully_inside count only fla…
params_used.linearisation: sRGB EOTF (IEC 61966-2-1) on the rendered 8-bit display output
params_used.luminance: mean over pixels of Y = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B (linear, Rec.709/BT.709)
params_used.max_resolvable_hz_note: max_resolvable_hz = sampling rate / 2 = timeline fps / step_frames / 2; flashing faster than this cannot be resolved from these samples
params_used.red_changed_area_fraction: share of pixels whose own red quantity moved >= red_delta since the previous sample
params_used.red_quantity: mean over pixels of max(0, R-G-B)*320 where R/(R+G+B) >= red_ratio_min, else 0
params_used.red_saturation: mean over pixels of R/(R+G+B) (linear); a pixel with R+G+B < red_floor counts as 0
params_used.transition: swing between confirmed extrema of amplitude >= delta (reversal confirmed after >= delta back); luminance swings also need min(start,end) < dark_max; marked +1/-1 on the first crossing of delta inside the monotonic run that reaches the extr…
params_used.windows: transitions with sample time in [start, start+window_s); window starts every window_hop_s while start+window_s <= range end (a range shorter than window_s gives one window ending at the range end)
